questions.text: Match the words (1–4) with their definitions (A–E).
questions.explanation: Правильно: pollution — damage to air, water or land caused by harmful substances; recycling — processing used materials so they can be used again; drought — a long period with little or no rain; flood — a large amount of water covering land that is usually dry.

pairs: damage to air, water or land caused by harmful substances
processing used materials so they can be used again
a long period with little or no rain
a large amount of water covering land that is usually dry
distractors: a violent storm with very strong winds

questions.text: Match the words (1–4) with their definitions (A–E).
questions.explanation: Правильно: luggage — the bags you take with you on a journey; departure — the act of leaving at the start of a journey; boarding pass — a card that allows you to get on a plane; souvenir — a thing you buy to remember a place you visited.

pairs: the bags you take with you on a journey
the act of leaving at the start of a journey
a card that allows you to get on a plane
a thing you buy to remember a place you visited
distractors: a document that allows you to enter a country

questions.text: Match the notices (1–4) with their meanings (A–E).
questions.explanation: Правильно: GATE CLOSES 20 MINUTES BEFORE DEPARTURE — Passengers must reach the gate in good time.; NO CAMPING — You cannot put up a tent here.; PLEASE DO NOT FEED THE ANIMALS — Visitors must not give food to the animals.; BOTTLES AND CANS ONLY — This bin is only for drink containers..

pairs: Passengers must reach the gate in good time.
You cannot put up a tent here.
PLEASE DO NOT FEED THE ANIMALS
Visitors must not give food to the animals.
This bin is only for drink containers.
distractors: You must buy a ticket in advance.

questions.text: Match the phrasal verbs (1–4) with their meanings (A–E).
questions.explanation: Правильно: set off — to start a journey; check in — to register at a hotel or airport; get away — to go somewhere for a holiday or rest; look around — to explore a place.

pairs: to register at a hotel or airport
to go somewhere for a holiday or rest

questions.text: Match the terms (1–4) with their definitions (A–E).
questions.explanation: Правильно: endangered species — animals or plants that may soon disappear; habitat — the natural home of an animal or plant; deforestation — cutting down large areas of forest; global warming — a rise in the average temperature of the Earth.

pairs: animals or plants that may soon disappear
the natural home of an animal or plant
cutting down large areas of forest
a rise in the average temperature of the Earth

questions.text: Match the words (1–4) with the words they go with (A–E).
questions.explanation: Правильно: carbon — footprint; renewable — energy; greenhouse — effect; acid — rain.

questions.text: Match the idioms (1–4) with their meanings (A–E).
questions.explanation: Правильно: off the beaten track — in a quiet place that few tourists visit; to hit the road — to start a journey; to travel light — to travel with very little luggage; a tourist trap — a place that charges tourists too much.

questions.text: Match the words (1–4) with their definitions (A–E).
questions.explanation: Правильно: journey — the act of travelling from one place to another; trip — a short visit to a place and back, often for pleasure; voyage — a long journey by sea or in space; excursion — a short organised trip, often as part of a holiday.

pairs: the act of travelling from one place to another
a short visit to a place and back, often for pleasure
a long journey by sea or in space
a short organised trip, often as part of a holiday
